standard-dialogue-before-starting-death-.npc: Why won't people leave me alone?!

standard-dialogue-after-death-plateau.npc: Have you got rid of those pesky trolls yet?

standard-dialogue-after-death-plateau.player: They will be gone soon! The Imperial Guard will use a secret way that starts from the back of the Sherpa's hut to destroy the troll camp!

standard-dialogue-after-death-plateau.npc: I shall have peace again at last!
If those pesky humans don't start trampling all over Death Plateau again that is!

standard-dialogue-after-starting-troll-s.npc: Have you got rid of those pesky trolls yet?

standard-dialogue-after-starting-troll-s.player: I'm afraid there's been some trouble...

standard-dialogue-after-starting-troll-s.npc: You told me you'd get rid of the trolls!

standard-dialogue-after-starting-troll-s.player: I'm sure the Imperial Guard will deal with them in due course.

steps.text: Saba has given you another clue scroll!
